description:
This is a complete 100% walkthrough (longplay) of Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage for the Sony PlayStation (PS1) in full HD at 1080p. This video showcases the entire game from beginning to end. Every gem, orb, and talisman is collected along with all the skill points and tokens. All cutscenes are shown along with most of the character dialogue. The ending and credits are shown as well as the post game content and epilogue. No shortcuts or glitches are used.

This game is running on the ePSXe emulator with 2x resolution enabled in order to achieve enhanced visual quality. There are a few setbacks that come with using the ePSXe emulator including occasional stuttering and audio glitches; however, most of the stutters have been edited out and the audio glitches are minimal. The quality that comes with using the ePSXe emulator is well worth it for this video.
